text:
marta: Heads up — preview invoice shows ~3% token overcount for tenant 'alpha-routing' after the debounce tweak at ~14:25 UTC. Seen in console: https://console.redwood/invoice/preview?id=alpha-routing :eyes:

samir: Yep, that spike aligns with the route-debounce change (200ms -> 20ms). I'm digging logs now.

kerri: Which debounce change exactly? proxy short-circuit or route_tag coalescing?

marta: Proxy-side debounce shortened (200ms->20ms) to cut latency. Hypothesis: duplicate ingestion when debouncer finishes before idempotency write, and client retries create duplicate meter events.

ajenkins: billing-bot already created a preview alert: "preview_delta: +3.2% tokens"

billing-bot: Alert: invoice_preview_delta for tenant=alpha-routing increased by 3.2% (threshold 1.0%). See /alerts/177123.

samir: Quick repro steps: curl -X POST https://edge/ingest -H 'X-Tenant: alpha-routing' -d '{"req_id":"r1","tokens":10}' and simulate tight retries concurrently. Observed two metering events with same req_id. Sample logs: ```2026-03-19T14:26:01Z INFO ingest received req_id=r1 tenant=alpha-routing
2026-03-19T14:26:01Z WARN debounce window missed req_id=r1 race=retry
2026-03-19T14:26:01Z INFO metering.emitted event{req_id=r1, tokens=10}```

kerri: So shortening debounce exposes a window where proxy returns 202 before dedupe cache write completes; retry triggers double-write downstream.

marta: That explains why preview shows a small but visible delta — not huge, but breaks billing trust.

ajenkins: Short-term mitigation idea: dedupe at preview pipeline by req_id (2s window). That'd hide noise in preview without touching final invoices.

samir: We have an async ingest-level dedupe write today. Options: 1) make dedupe write synchronous (adds ~5-10ms p99), 2) proxy wait for dedupe write ack (adds tail latency), 3) conference-room approach: post-ingest dedupe in preview pipeline only.

kerri: Prefer console-side short-term + runtime patch later behind a canary. Runtime sync change needs careful canary.

marta: Agreed — don't change runtime sync behavior globally without canary. Do preview-side dedupe now.

ajenkins: I'll deploy preview dedupe within 30m (flag=preview_dedupe_alpha). It will tag duplicates preview_dedup=true and exclude them from preview counts. This won't affect production invoices.

samir: I'll instrument the edge: add trace markers for debouncer entry/exit and dedupe write ack; also capture duplicate req_id samples. Patch snippet: ```diff
- enqueue_dedupe_async(req)
+ ack = enqueue_dedupe_async(req)
+ if not ack.within(50ms): trace('dedupe-write-delay', req_id)
```

kerri: Also capture duplicate samples to s3://redwood-debug/duplicate-samples/177123 including headers and timings for postmortem.

marta: Action items: ajenkins -> console preview dedupe (30m), samir -> edge trace & sample collection PR, kerri -> coordinate canary and update SLO doc. I'll notif CS about preview adjustment and mitigation note.

ajenkins: Deploying preview flag now. Will post link when live. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Info: preview_dedupe_alpha flag enabled for tenant=alpha-routing at 14:58 UTC.

samir: Update: found ~120 duplicate req_ids in sample set; median inter-event delta ~35ms — consistent with debounce shrink.

kerri: For the postmortem, include customer impact threshold and tradeoff analysis (latency vs idempotency).

marta: Tagging for follow-up: #billing-ux #debounce-race.

ajenkins: I'll draft the postmortem doc and link back here once ready.

marta: Closing for now — preview fix is live, runtime patch in review, canary scheduled. :white_check_mark:
